kpis.description_fr: Revenus récurrents Subscription et Support (80% du software revenue 2023). KPI clé du modèle SaaS Dassault Systèmes (transition LICENSE -> SUBSCRIPTION).
kpis.description_en: Recurring Subscription and Support revenue (80% of software revenue 2023). Key KPI of Dassault Systemes SaaS model.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus logiciels totaux (Subscription + Licenses + Support). 90% du CA. Inclut CATIA, SOLIDWORKS, ENOVIA, SIMULIA, DELMIA, MEDIDATA, 3DEXPERIENCE platform.
kpis.description_en: Total software revenue (Subscription + Licenses + Support). 90% of sales. Includes CATIA, SOLIDWORKS, ENOVIA, SIMULIA, DELMIA, MEDIDATA, 3DEXPERIENCE platform.

kpis.description_fr: Revenus licences perpétuelles (modèle historique). En déclin volontaire au profit de Subscription. 20% du software revenue.
kpis.description_en: Perpetual license revenue (historical model). Deliberately declining in favor of Subscription. 20% of software revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Services consulting et déploiement (méthodologie, design, formation). 10% du CA.
kpis.description_en: Consulting and deployment services (methodology, design, training). 10% of sales.

kpis.description_fr: Part des revenus récurrents (Subscription + Support) sur le software revenue total. Métrique structurelle du shift SaaS.
kpis.description_en: Recurring revenue share (Subscription + Support) of total software revenue.

kpis.description_fr: Chiffre d'affaires consolidé Dassault Systèmes. CAGR 5 ans environ 10%. CAC 40.
kpis.description_en: Dassault Systemes consolidated revenue. 5-year CAGR around 10%. CAC 40.

notes: Source URD AMF 2021-2023. Marques : CATIA, SOLIDWORKS, ENOVIA, SIMULIA, DELMIA, MEDIDATA, 3DEXPERIENCE platform.
